mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, c.title, c.preconditions, c.steps, c.expected_result AS expectedResult, c.priority, c.status, c.owner, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM test_case c LEFT JOIN project p ON c.project_id = p.id
mapper.select: WHERE c.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_case (project_id, title, preconditions, steps, expected_result, priority, status, owner, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{title}, #{preconditions}, #{steps}, #{expectedResult}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{owner}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
